subject: Council Communications and Outreach Strategy
overview: The committee met to discuss Resolution 24-015 regarding modernizing City Council public engagement and outreach. Members approved five motions to establish an opt-in council newsletter, coordinate distribution with city staff, draft a social media policy, and prepare a municipal budget survey.

items.title: Resolution 24-015: Modernizing Council Communications and Outreach
items.summary: Following discussion with the administration and public comment regarding maintaining factual, nonpartisan standards, the committee approved five motions to create a council newsletter with rotating authorship, coordinate with staff on email distribution, draft social media guidelines, and prepare a draft budget survey.
